ratings.note: Keyboard users above 480 px only; focus meets results before search, a detour not a block; recurs each visit.
Every basket visit shows only 'held while you finish'; uncertainty about the hold rather than a failure in itself; recurs each reservation.
Seen on every visit but has no effect on completing any task; aesthetic only.
Sessions earlier than the chosen day are offered on every basket visit; may cause a mismatched choice that the confirm summary shows.
Every phone visit; wrapped labels still read and work, so cosmetic.
Desktop short pages only; purely visual.
Desktop only; empty space has no task effect.
Members typing digits only; the example shows the fix, so a short delay; recurs per wrong attempt.
Desktop/tablet widths; cramped three-line cards slow scanning of dates at the session step.
Screen-reader users pressing Reserve first; silent validation with focus on an unexplained date is a significant difficulty; once learned they choose a day first.
Date-filter users; the hint misdescribes results so later-available tools look absent; recurs each use.
Every phone visit to find; search out of the first view. Departed from s=3: with ten tools, browsing is a short detour.
Toast briefly covers one weekday header; transient and cosmetic.
Screen-reader landmark users; the main action sits outside main but is still reachable in reading order.
Forced colours at narrow widths is rare, but the 320 px capture shows session days indistinguishable, so those members may pick a closed day; not overcome by learning.
Every reservation; reversed chronology (seen in the 375 px basket) invites picking the wrong week at the step that sets the collection date; confirm summary allows a catch.

Every reservation decides collection twice; mismatched day and session reach the confirm page and can trigger errors. Departed from s=4: the session on confirm is explicit and the error is recoverable before commit.
First-time members do not know session days and most calendar days are closed; the closed day is accepted silently and fails later.
Every reservation; the first Saturday read is the wrong week; caught only by reading the confirm summary.
Occasional double taps during the unindicated 1.5 s wait; a duplicate reservation ties up one-of-a-kind stock and needs desk reconciliation.
Occasional mis-taps; recovery means redoing find, loan length and day; once per mistake.
Every tool page lacks a month caption; brief uncertainty, resolved once a day is chosen.
Desktop alignment lapse of the action bar button; no task effect from the misalignment itself.

Closed days are commonly picked by first-time members; the confirm screenshot shows the failure only at the last step, with no link to change the day (Change goes to the session), effectively blocking and forcing a restart or a call.
Tools with later availability; the reservation can be set for a day the tool is still out, risking a wasted trip.
Every phone visit; wrapped labels remain readable and usable.
Desktop widths; uneven grid slows scanning of session dates.
Filter users; native date format is a minor mismatch with en-GB dates, quickly understood.
Members autofilling +44; one retry with reformatting; recurs each time in that format.
Members at 320 px or 400% zoom; cards cut off with horizontal scrolling on the main list; not overcome by learning.
Every add on a phone; feedback vanishes and the way on is out of view; recoverable by scrolling up.
Every find visit; identical placeholders give no recognition aid, but names still distinguish tools.
Dark mode is common; 3.1:1 availability text is hard to read for older members; persists on each dark-mode visit.
Every phone visit; the distinguishing words of similar tools are hidden; recoverable on the tool page heading.
Dark mode; badge shape inconsistency only, text still present.
Screen-reader heading navigation; flat outline loses grouping but content remains reachable.
Every completed reservation; two FT- identifiers may be confused at the desk, resolved by conversation.
Every phone visit to find; search after ten cards. Departed from s=3: with ten tools, browsing is a short detour.
Every Reserve; a 1.3 s confirmation is too short to notice, leading to doubt or re-taps.
Every reservation, twice; no visible busy state for over a second invites re-taps on commit; not learned away.
First-time members (primary group) may take 'Reserve this tool' plus 'Added to your basket' as done; the tool is not reserved and nothing is set aside at the session.
Every phone visit; search out of the first view. Departed from s=3: with ten tools, browsing is a short detour.
Keyboard users opening the list are trapped until they choose an option; significant difficulty, overcome once learned.
Members planning in short bursts often exceed 10 minutes; after expiry Continue fails every time with no cause or fix, a dead end in the critical journey.
Desktop short pages only; visual.
Searches in members' own words or for unstocked tools show the full list with no message; misleading but recoverable by browsing.
Screen-reader users hear only the value 'One week, button'; the label is lost on each visit, though the preceding heading gives some context.
Every tool page; ragged value columns are visual only.
Every add; no lasting sign or link onward on the page; recoverable through the header link.
Members using Change after typing (core task 2) lose three fields and may only notice through errors on Confirm.
Dark mode; badge style inconsistency, no task effect.
Every tool page; offset value columns are visual only.
No-match searches are common with members' wording; sighted users see an unchanged list and screen-reader users hear nothing, a misleading outcome.
Phone users opening the loan list; options hidden under the fixed bar; can scroll.
Every completed reservation leaves 'Basket (1)'; contradictory status and possible re-checkout persist until removed.
Every basket visit; reversed visual vs focus order invites the wrong session.
Rare four-tool baskets; the rule is broken silently and resolved at the desk.
Every tool page lacks a month label; brief uncertainty, resolved once a day is chosen.
Desktop alignment lapse only.
Every reservation; visual order reversed against reading and arrow-key order (375 px capture), so focus moves against the layout and the wrong week can be chosen; caught on confirm.
Every reservation; latest-first sessions invite the wrong week.
Brand and identity only; no task effect.
Members often exceed 10 minutes while planning; the limit is never stated or extendable, so the hold is lost at the last step.
Desktop; cramped wrapped cards slow scanning of sessions.
Every phone visit truncates names; the two drills look the same, risking the wrong tool; recoverable on the tool page.
Baskets with later-available tools; an earlier session proceeds without warning, risking a wasted trip to a short session.
Every find visit; placeholders give no recognition aid but names distinguish tools.
Keyboard users on every tool page; up to 21 Tab stops, tedious but passable.
Every completed reservation shows 'Basket (1)'; contradictory status persists until removed by hand.
Every reservation; latest-first sessions invite the wrong week.
Every phone visit; similar tool names become indistinguishable; recoverable on the tool page.
Transient toast overlap of a weekday header; cosmetic.
Members wanting the date filter (top task 3) may miss the icon-only button; cards still show dates.
Rare: an error followed by removing everything; confusing, but the 'Find a tool' link is present.
Screen-reader users of the filter may miss the hint's meaning; small effect, not overcome by learning.
Phone filter users see no change near the control; recoverable by scrolling up.
